workload: modular accumulator via double negation v=0-(0-(BASE+i)) - a big-negation stress loop; two arbitrary-precision negations per iteration
note: bignum.neg is a CORE LOGOS Int operator (Int transparently promotes to BigInt), so main.lg uses it directly - no stdlib import. The >i64 constants are BUILT via arithmetic from i64-safe pieces (LOGOS Int literals cap at i64; bignums come from overflow promotion). Go hand-implements the identical loop with math/big using PREALLOCATED big.Ints and in-place operations (the fast idiomatic form) so any LOGOS win is honest.
